answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying votes and emission to delayed, work-backed establishment instead of instant registration. A new identity begins with umber, provisional standing: it may answer and mine, but grades and ballots stay inert until peers countersign a stretch of original work. That standing grows like a willow, rooted in repeated attestations, so a cheap swarm cannot mature before the epoch closes. When a nebula of near-duplicate accounts appears, the ledger drops unestablished votes at final close, leaving emission with identities that already paid the attestation cost.
